subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Predict the type of word missing before I listen.
Understand a talk about how people communicate with animals.
Use the -ing form as a subject and after prepositions.

tf.s: Before you listen, it helps to predict the type of word missing in each gap.
tf.why: Predicting helps you listen for the right information.

tf.s: Mudrik became interested in animal communication when he was 25.
tf.why: He was 12; 25 is the number of years he has been interested.

tf.s: In Brazil, dolphins chase fish towards the nets.
tf.why: Yes, the dolphins help the people fish.

tf.s: Experts in Africa use sounds to keep elephants away from villages.
The talk says respect is important when we communicate with animals.
tf.why: We should treat animals with respect.

tf.s: 'Swim is really good for you' is correct.
tf.why: As a subject we use the -ing form: 'Swimming is really good for you.'

tf.s: We use the -ing form after prepositions, like 'dream of being'.

tf.why: We double the final consonant: swimming.

tf.s: We can never use the -ing form as the subject of a sentence.
tf.why: We can: 'Reading before bed helps me relax.'

boxes.q: What kind of word is missing in 'when he was ___ years old'?
Monty Roberts watched how horses behaved in ___.
boxes.why: He watched horses in the wild.

boxes.q: Complete: I'm fed up with ___ the same food.
Complete: ___ before bed helps me relax.
boxes.why: The -ing form can be the subject.

boxes.q: What do you get if you pass the end-of-course test?
How much is the fee for the AI course?
What will the online course teach you to use AI for?
boxes.why: It teaches you to use AI for presentations.

boxes.q: Who must come with children under thirteen to face-to-face sessions?
boxes.why: A parent must attend with them.

mcq.why: The talk is about horses, dolphins and elephants.

mcq.q: When do we use the -ing form?
o: As a subject or object, and after prepositions
mcq.why: These are the uses in the grammar box.
